name: multica
description: 任务台账 / issue 追踪：Trellis 任务与 issue 同步、WIMTB 上台账
fallback: 台账退化为本地 .trellis/tasks/ 目录 + sendbox 交办；WIMTB 退化为本地留档，不上台账
auth: `multica login`；workspace 经 env `MULTICA_WORKSPACE_ID`；凭据不入表
notes: <workspace/project 具体 ID 进这里，不进 guide>；只读候选：issue get/list/search/runs/run-messages、project get/list；Trellis 接点：config.yaml hooks after_start/after_archive → scripts/trellis_multica_sync.py
